purpose: Five theme palettes differentiated and three middle-row obstacles per theme replaced with visibly raised solid square blocks; initial originals retained.

requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: opaque 3x3 TOP-DOWN scenery tile sheet for a polished Greek-underworld 2D action game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its EXACT equal 3 columns x 3 rows, tile arrangement, overhead camera, cohesive hand-painted pixel-art edge style, and fully opaque square output. No margins, no text, no sheet divider lines.
Two targeted changes: (1) enforce the thematic stone palette below across all nine cells, (2) REPLACE ONLY THE MIDDLE ROW objects with visibly solid high masonry blocks.
Color palette: REFUGE = distinctly WARM SANDSTONE BEIGE, muted buff and tawny limestone with honey-brown joints and restrained antique bronze. The entire floor must visibly read beige sandstone, not neutral grey or blue. Calm welcoming warm grey-beige, medium-low saturation.
TOP ROW (3 cells): preserve existing calm floor slab layouts, joints and restrained weathering. All surfaces FLAT, walkable, seamless tiling edges; deliberately low contrast so characters and projectiles stay readable. Change colors as specified, not the layout.
MIDDLE ROW (3 cells): REPLACE the three current flat recessed floor panels. Each must now be a MASSIVE SINGLE SQUARE SOLID STONE BLOCK, obviously elevated and unwalkable. A large smooth lighter-colored stone top cap occupies about 65-70% of the tile; broad thick light upper bevel, then thick DARK SOLID VERTICAL SIDE WALLS on ALL FOUR SIDES within the square tile, especially a strong dark front-facing face along the bottom. It must look like a heavy stone cube with real thickness, NOT a framed floor slab, NOT a shallow carved tile, NOT a hollow recess or pedestal ring. Keep the orthographic top-down plan a FULL SQUARE filling at least95% of the cell so all four collision corners are visibly solid. No surrounding walkable paving or empty corners. No tall column. Three subtle variants: intact cap, single broad chip, restrained corner reinforcement. Make top face lighter and smoother than the base floor; chunky readable shapes must still look like a block at16x16 pixels. Do not engrave complex symbols onto block tops.
BOTTOM ROW (3 cells): preserve existing flat Greek motifs and pavers, recolor in this theme. All decoration remains FLAT, no extra objects, no new hazards, no luminous symbols.
Output: one square, opaque PNG tile sheet EXACTLY3x3 equal cells. Preserve the first and third rows' geometry. Medium restrained saturation but a clearly identifiable theme hue. No blur, no actors, no borders, no words, no vignette.
